headline: Undav's brace secures Germany's spot in World Cup knockouts
summary: Germany defeats Ivory Coast with a standout performance from Deniz Undav, ending a period of struggle to advance to the second round.
details: Germany has advanced to the knockout stages of the World Cup after defeating Ivory Coast in a high-stakes encounter.
Deniz Undav was the star of the match, scoring two goals to secure the victory for the German side.
The win marks a significant turnaround for Germany, who had been struggling to find the back of the net in previous matches.
Despite a strong challenge from Ivory Coast, Germany managed to hold their lead and secure their progression to the second round.

headline_marked: Brazil's [[Raphinha to miss final group match]] due to hamstring injury
headline: Brazil's Raphinha to miss final group match due to hamstring injury
summary: The Brazilian winger will be unavailable for the clash against Scotland, but the CBF hopes he can return for the knockout stages.
details: The Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) has confirmed that winger Raphinha suffered a hamstring injury in his right thigh during the first half of the match against Haiti.
Due to the injury, Raphinha will miss Brazil's final group stage match against Scotland this coming Thursday.
Despite the setback, the CBF stated there are no plans to remove him from the World Cup squad, as they believe he can recover in time for the tournament.
The CBF is specifically aiming to have the player fit for the Round of 16, which takes place approximately two weeks from now, provided Brazil advances.
According to the CBF, Raphinha is currently undergoing intensive treatment and a rehabilitation program under the supervision of the national team's medical staff.
The team cannot replace Raphinha with another player because tournament rules prohibit adding new players once the final squad has been registered.
caption:
A major blow for Brazil: Raphinha is officially out of the final group game.

The Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) has confirmed that winger Raphinha suffered a hamstring injury in his right thigh during the first half of the match against Haiti.

Due to the injury, Raphinha will miss Brazil's final group stage match against Scotland this coming Thursday.

Despite the setback, the CBF stated there are no plans to remove him from the World Cup squad, as they believe he can recover in time for the tournament.

The CBF is specifically aiming to have the player fit for the Round of 16, which takes place approximately two weeks from now, provided Brazil advances.

According to the CBF, Raphinha is currently undergoing intensive treatment and a rehabilitation program under the supervision of the national team's medical staff.

The team cannot replace Raphinha with another player because tournament rules prohibit adding new players once the final squad has been registered.

#Brazil #WorldCup #Raphinha #FootballNews #CBF
